request.prompt: Image 1 is the real identity photograph of the exact ordinary white pre-facelift Lada Granta five-door liftback. Image 2 is an incomplete first catalog sample of this same car, provided only as an editing target. Make a new complete transparent catalog sample of this exact car, keeping its old rectangular headlamps, black two-bar grille and Lada emblem, five-door liftback roof/hatch, four side doors, rain guards, black mirrors and handles, white paint, wheel covers, side creases and right-facing front three-quarter source view. Correct the framing decisively: make the entire car substantially smaller within a roomy landscape canvas, about 80 percent of image width; all bodywork, both wheels, mirrors and the ENTIRE roof antenna including its thin tip must have broad transparent breathing room, at least 8 percent canvas clearance above the antenna and below the tire bottoms. The antenna must be a complete continuous stock antenna, not cropped, doubled or extended out of the frame. Remove any floating fragments, colored specks and pale background fringe outside the silhouette. Keep realistic interior and glass; no transparent holes through windscreen. Clean factory-condition paint; no dirt, rust or unrelated background reflections. Actual RGBA transparency. No road, snow, floor, shadow, reflection, text, watermark or checkerboard. Do not invent Sport/Cross trim, change body type, mirror the vehicle or impose a pickup-style camera. This is a proposed method-validation sample, not a declared final design standard.

request.prompt: Use this photo as the sole vehicle identity reference. Create a clean photorealistic catalog cutout of this exact ordinary silver pre-facelift Lada Granta four-door SEDAN. Preserve the sedan rear trunk/body, four side doors, rear side window, short roof antenna, plain black mirrors and door handles, plain steel wheels with small center covers, rectangular old-style headlamps with amber indicators, black two-bar grille with Lada emblem and the long silver bar, hood creases, bumper air opening, and plain circular fog-light blanks. No Sport trim, no liftback body, no alloy wheels, no added fog lamps. Keep a right-facing front three-quarter camera view close to the source; show the entire car, all body extremities, both visible tires and the complete roof antenna, with generous transparent margins on every side and above and below. Remove the buildings, white SUV, road, reflections of surroundings, windshield ornament, license text, stains, rust and scratches, restoring a clean factory-condition silver finish without changing trim. Real glass and interior remain, not transparent holes. Actual RGBA transparent background, no floor, no contact shadow or reflection. Clean continuous natural silhouette without fringe or floating fragments. No text, watermark, border or checkerboard. This is produced under a transparent shadow-free working default; do not invent a precise model year.
